events.content: Set each category `Link` to `prefetch={true}` in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx). Next can fetch that category URL’s heading and products in the background, so navigation can use the prefetched result without waiting for a server render on click. The `/catalog?category=...` URLs are unchanged.
